description: CloudBurst distributes user-supplied Python ensemble simulations across a Docker swarm, with queued jobs and configurable result storage. This resource is provided by CitiLogics (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: MIT. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Deployment uses external cloud infrastructure and credentials. The software licence does not cover compute charges. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
